events.subtitle: Zainichi Funk at Billboard Live TOKYO 2026 — special guest Maki Goto
events.category: Japanese deep funk / Horn-driven groove / Current cross-genre collaboration
events.factual_description: Billboard Live Tokyo presents Zainichi Funk on Sunday, September 27, 2026, with sets at 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM. The official event page lists the seven-piece band of Kenta Hamano, Keita Murakami, Masaki Nagata, Gentle Kubota, Motoi Murakami, Takehide Hashimoto, and Kei Kogane-maru, with Maki Goto as special guest vocalist. Billboard describes the group as a new-era deep-funk band descended from the James Brown lineage and identifies this as its third consecutive Billboard Live premium club appearance. KAKUBARHYTHM, the band's official label/management, confirms Goto's guest appearance and says it follows her 2026 collaboration with Hamano on the theme song 'Oh-hey' for the drama Ginga no Ippyo. The official pages confirm first-stage doors at 2:00 PM / start at 3:00 PM and second-stage doors at 5:00 PM / start at 6:00 PM.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care is not celebrity crossover. Zainichi Funk already runs on a real seven-piece funk engine: bass and drums lock the pocket while trombone, trumpet, saxophone and guitar give Hamano's vocal attack a hard, horn-driven frame. Goto enters because of a current 2026 collaboration rather than as a decorative guest, which makes the interesting question musical: what happens when a mainstream J-pop voice is forced inside this band's deep-funk pocket and call-and-response logic? That contrast gives this year's Billboard stop a concrete identity beyond another return engagement.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two sets if September 27 overlaps a Tokyo stay, especially if the Japan thread includes groove, horn sections and contemporary cross-genre collisions. The guest collaboration makes this edition more distinctive than a routine club return, but the band's recurring Billboard relationship and active current work mean it should complement rather than displace a genuinely scarce master, premiere, farewell or one-off elsewhere in Kanto.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para ponerla en el tablero no es el crossover de celebridades. Zainichi Funk ya funciona como una máquina real de siete músicos: bajo y batería amarran el pocket mientras trombón, trompeta, sax y guitarra le dan un marco duro y lleno de metales a la voz de Hamano. Goto entra por una colaboración vigente de 2026, no como invitada decorativa, y ahí está la pregunta musical: qué pasa cuando una voz muy asociada al J-pop mainstream tiene que meterse dentro del deep funk, el call-and-response y el groove de esta banda. Ese contraste le da a la fecha de Billboard una identidad concreta más allá de otra visita anual.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets si el 27 de septiembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, sobre todo si el hilo japonés viene siguiendo groove, secciones de metales y cruces contemporáneos. La colaboración con Goto vuelve esta edición más particular que una fecha rutinaria del grupo, pero la relación recurrente con Billboard y el trabajo actual de la banda hacen que complemente, y no desplace, a un maestro realmente escaso, un estreno, una despedida o un one-off en otro punto de Kanto.
